name: SOC Simulation 01 - Endpoint Compromise & Credential Access Investigation
description: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator Layer mapping the complete attack lifecycle of SOC Simulation 01: FreeClude Meterpreter payload delivery, reverse HTTP C2, host discovery, local account and scheduled task persistence, certutil ingress tool transfer, and Mimikatz privilege::debug preparation.

techniques.comment: CONFIRMED: Payload delivered via Telegram Web service (Sysmon Event 15 Zone.Identifier HostUrl=https://web.telegram.org/).
CONFIRMED: User executed FreeClude.exe from Downloads directory via explorer.exe (Sysmon Event 1, IntegrityLevel High).
CONFIRMED: FreeClude.exe spawned cmd.exe (PID 6316) for post-exploitation command execution.
CONFIRMED: Reverse HTTP Meterpreter session established from 192.168.110.156:55196 to 192.168.110.141:33398 (Sysmon Event 3).
CONFIRMED: Execution of whoami.exe returning SH-WIN10\saad (Sysmon Event 1).
CONFIRMED: Execution of hostname.exe and systeminfo.exe to enumerate system properties (Sysmon Event 1).
CONFIRMED: Created local account ClaudeBackdoor using net user ClaudeBackdoor password /add (Sysmon Event 1, Sec 4720).
CONFIRMED: Added ClaudeBackdoor to local Administrators group (Sysmon Event 1, Sec 4732).
CONFIRMED: Created scheduled task GetClaudeBackdoor executing FreeClude.exe at logon as SYSTEM (Sysmon Event 1/7, Sec 4698).
CONFIRMED: Cleanup of temporary backdoor account via net user ClaudeBackdoor /delete (Sysmon Event 1, Sec 4726).
CONFIRMED: Ingress tool transfer using certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f to download mimikatz.exe as GetClaude.exe (Sysmon Event 1/3/11).
CONFIRMED: Execution of GetClaude.exe (Mimikatz 2.2.0) and invocation of privilege::debug (Sysmon Event 1).
CONDITIONAL: Preparation observed (privilege::debug OK), but LSASS memory dumping requires Sysmon Event 10 / sekurlsa::logonpasswords confirmation.
